name: Moiré Weave
desc: Two-to-four families of thin parallel threads — straight razor gratings or watered-silk waves — rotate at slightly different rates and slide out of register, blooming shimmering moiré interference bands that breathe and sweep across the frame, rendered as Bridget-Riley black-and-white op-art, neon duotone, thermal false-color, cyan blueprint, or warm risograph misprint.

density.doc: line count per family — grating fineness (1st poke)

weave.doc: waviness — 0 straight razor op-art, 1 watered-silk curves (2nd poke)

scale.doc: grating zoom — line spacing vs design size

hue.doc: ink / glow base hue (ignored by opart b&w)

mismatch.doc: per-family period detune → vernier fringe travel (0.5=matched)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg, lower=translucent overlay)
